eatingOutPriceLevel.basis: Price level of restaurants and hotels relative to Finland, World Bank International Comparison Program 2021.
eatingOutPriceLevel.limitations: The programme prices restaurants and hotels together, so hotel prices are part of this figure.

coldestMonthMean.basis: Average temperature of the coldest month, Tallinn, climate normals 1991-2020.
coldestMonthMean.limitations: The published table does not name the station; Tallinn's main station is Tallinn-Harku.

warmestMonthMeanMax.basis: Average daily high of the warmest month, Tallinn, climate normals 1991-2020.
warmestMonthMeanMax.limitations: The published table does not name the station; Tallinn's main station is Tallinn-Harku.

decemberDaylight.basis: Sunrise to sunset on 21 December at latitude 59.44°, calculated.

foreignBornShare.basis: Foreign-born residents as a share of the population of the city (Urban Audit, DE2009I).
foreignBornShare.limitations: Includes many long-term residents born elsewhere in the former Soviet Union.

carCommuteShare.basis: Share of journeys to work by car or motorcycle (Urban Audit, TT1012V).

cityWide.basis: €15.10 per m² × 50 m², the app's assumed size for 1 bedroom.
cityWide.limitations: Average asking rent per m² of 1,168 flats advertised on KV.EE in Tallinn in August 2026, as reported by Adaur; no split by size. Districts range from €12.5 (Lasnamäe) to €16.6 (Põhja-Tallinn). Asking rents exclude utilities and building charges (kommunaalkulud), which tenants pay on top.

rent.dwelling: flat of any size, utilities not included
rent.adjustment: Converted from a rent per m² at 50 m².

cityWide.limitations: Average asking rent per m² of 1,168 flats advertised on KV.EE in Tallinn in August 2026, as reported by Adaur; no split by size. rent.dwelling: flat of any size, utilities not included
rent.adjustment: Converted from a rent per m² at 70 m².

transitPassAdult.basis: Public transport in Tallinn is free for people registered as Tallinn residents in the population register; others pay €30 for a 30-day ticket.
transitPassAdult.limitations: Free only once you are registered as living in Tallinn; until then, €30 a month.

healthcarePerPerson.basis: Household out-of-pocket health spending per inhabitant in Estonia (€487.52 a year).
healthcarePerPerson.limitations: A national average across all ages; spending is lower for most working-age adults and higher for older people.

childcarePerChild.basis: From 1 September 2026, Tallinn's municipal kindergartens and childcare groups charge no place fee when the child and both parents (or the single parent) are registered in Tallinn; meals have been free since 2017.
childcarePerChild.limitations: Requires registration in Tallinn. Private kindergartens charge fees. A municipal place is not guaranteed at a particular kindergarten.

groceriesPerAdultEquivalent.basis: Average spending in Finland on food and drink at home, €362 a month per adult equivalent in 2024, priced here: prices are 1.03 times Finland's.
groceriesPerAdultEquivalent.limitations: Price levels from the 2021 international comparison, moved to 2024 with overall inflation; national prices, so the city itself may differ.

communicationsPerAdultEquivalent.basis: Average spending in Finland on phone and internet (services and devices), €70 a month per adult equivalent in 2024, priced here: prices are 1.01 times Finland's.
communicationsPerAdultEquivalent.limitations: Price levels from the 2021 international comparison, moved to 2024 with overall inflation; national prices, so the city itself may differ.

eatingOut.basis: Average spending in Finland on eating out and hotels, €196 a month per adult equivalent in 2024, priced here: prices are 0.84 times Finland's.
eatingOut.limitations: Price levels from the 2021 international comparison, moved to 2024 with overall inflation; national prices, so the city itself may differ.

recreation.basis: Average spending in Finland on leisure and holidays, €251 a month per adult equivalent in 2024, priced here: prices are 0.89 times Finland's.
recreation.limitations: Price levels from the 2021 international comparison, moved to 2024 with overall inflation; national prices, so the city itself may differ.

clothing.basis: Average spending in Finland on clothes and shoes, €111 a month per adult equivalent in 2024, priced here: prices are 1.10 times Finland's.
clothing.limitations: Price levels from the 2021 international comparison, moved to 2024 with overall inflation; national prices, so the city itself may differ.
